snippet_primary: "It costs $0 to start selling on Gumroad, and we charge no monthly fees, seriously. When you make a sale, we charge a 10% flat fee. This does not include credit card processing or PayPal fees, but there are no monthly payments or hidden charges."
subject_exact: Costos de venta según el help center: $0 para empezar, sin cuotas mensuales; 10% flat fee por venta, sin incluir procesamiento de tarjeta ni fees de PayPal, sin pagos mensuales ni cargos ocultos
local_qualifiers: This does not include credit card processing or PayPal fees
parser_notes: Capas declaradas: fee de plataforma vs fees de procesamiento excluidas.
